svg.title: Step 7 mockup 08: Standings, the final cut and the final (organiser)
svg.text: 08 · Standings, the final cut and the final (organiser)
Use case: an organiser checks the standings before Sunday, confirms the finalists, scores the final and adds the champions' photos

g.text: Demo Game Cup · standings after 5 of 6 sessions
the cut: top 10 play the final
Places 10 and 11 are tied on every rule
The rules say a tie-break game decides; record its winner here.

svg.text: The final · ranks and the champions' photos

g.text: Sun 13:00 · Stage · 10 finalists · final ranks decide the champion
PHOTOS · SHOWN ON THE WINNER CARD AND THE CHAMPIONS PAGE
Crowning saves the final's result: Moments plays the Champion story (built).

svg.text: Standings: points over all sessions, no-shows excluded; ▲▼ for the last change (legacy rules, D3).
Tie-break chain, the legacy had none: more wins, then more sessions, then a crew-recorded game (D3).
The cut is a setting (top 10 by default); finalists are confirmed, not auto-locked (U11).
Final ranks lead the standings once scored; points never change (legacy final.ts, kept).
Photos go to the tenant's files volume, four slots as in the legacy, with consent (D9, L5).
Crowning emits tournament.match.finished on the final session: the winner card (built).
